name: A call from home
prompt: Your phone lights up with your mother's number. It has been a while.

outcome.told: It stops after six rings. You look at it for a while.
outcome.line: {you} let a call from home ring out.

outcome.told: She asks about work and the flat and tells you about the neighbours. You stay on longer than you meant to.
outcome.line: {you} talked with family on the phone for an hour.
